name: Vercel AI SDK
summary: A ToolLoopAgent on the @ai-sdk/anthropic provider, with MCP tools from @ai-sdk/mcp's Streamable HTTP client and calculate defined with tool() and a zod schema.
notes: ai 7.0.163 ToolLoopAgent (the v7 agent class; isStepCount(max_turns) as stopWhen, since the default is 20 steps), maxOutputTokens = max_tokens. createAnthropic needs the versioned base URL, so the adapter appends /v1 to ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL. MCP: @ai-sdk/mcp createMCPClient with its built-in Streamable HTTP transport ({type: 'http'}) and its own StdioMCPTransport (@ai-sdk/mcp/mcp-stdio), so @modelcontextprotocol/sdk is not needed; it probes server/discover first and falls back to initialize on the lab servers' -32601. Tools keep their raw MCP names (no server prefix); tool() schemas gain a $schema key. Sends tool_choice {type:'auto'} explicitly and no sampling params, so no shims. No prompt caching: the provider adds cache_control only when asked via providerOptions. result.text is the last step's text. The model runs parallel tool calls (63 tool calls in 10 requests on haiku).
